text: Regulatory Compliance and TRAI Disclosure Policy Document ID: Policy_C28_regulatory_compliance Category: C28 — Regulatory & Compliance (TRAI) Department: Legal Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Policy Statement Describes NovaTel's commitment to compliance with applicable telecom regulatory requirements, including tariff transparency, Quality of Service (QoS) reporting, and consumer protection rules. Purpose Ensures consistent, compliant, and customer-fair treatment across all channels and customer segments. Scope Applies to all prepaid, postpaid, and (where noted) enterprise customers, and to all NovaTel-authorised channels. Definitions **Customer** — any individual or entity holding an active NovaTel connection or account. **Working day** — a business day excluding weekends and public holidays. Eligibility Applies to customers with an active, KYC-verified account in good standing, subject to the rules and exceptions below. Rules Quarterly QoS metrics are published on the NovaTel website's Regulatory Disclosures section. DND/UCC, MNP, and KYC processes are implemented in line with the applicable TRAI regulations in force. This policy is reviewed whenever a material regulatory change is notified by TRAI or the Department of Telecommunications. Exceptions Enterprise/pooled accounts may follow their signed commercial agreement instead. Approval Requirements Exceptions to standard rules require documented supervisor or department-head approval before being applied. Responsibilities Compliance Requirements This policy is designed to align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DoT guidance) as general background context; it is not a substitute for legal advice.
